list.name: node
list.label: Nœud
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes", start: -7d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes", start: -7d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "uptime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000 then 0.0 else 1.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "uptime"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.uptime}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "cpu"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.cpu}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.memtotal > 0.0 then r.memused / r.memtotal else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "swapused" or r._field == "swaptotal"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.swaptotal > 0.0 then r.swapused / r.swaptotal else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "blocks"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.blocks > 0.0 then r.used / r.blocks else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "avg1" or r._field == "avg5" or r._field == "avg15" or r._field == "cpus"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({avg1: r.avg1, avg5: r.avg5, avg15: r.avg15, cpus: r.cpus}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "wait")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "avg1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "avg5")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "avg15")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "cpus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "memused")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "memtotal")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "arcsize")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "swapused")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "blocks"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.blocks > 0.0 then r.used / r.blocks else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "receive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.instance !~ /^(fwbr|fwpr|fwln|tap|veth|lo$)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 8.0, iface: r.instance}))
  |> group(columns: ["iface"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "transmit")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.instance !~ /^(fwbr|fwpr|fwln|tap|veth|lo$)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 8.0, iface: r.instance}))
  |> group(columns: ["iface"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["nodename", "host", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: r.host, type: r.type, used: r.used, total: r.total, avail: r.avail, _value: r.used / r.total}))
  |> unique(column: "storage")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: r.storage, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["nodename", "host", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: r.host, type: r.type, used: r.used, total: r.total, avail: r.avail, _value: r.used / r.total}))
  |> unique(column: "storage")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: r.storage, type: r.type, used: r.used, avail: r.avail, total: r.total, pct: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["nodename", "host"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.total, storage: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])

panels.title: Débit par disque
panels.description: Ces graphiques viennent de l'agent proxmox-grafana installé sur le nœud.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_disk" and r._field == "read_bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, disk: r.disk}))
  |> group(columns: ["disk"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_disk" and r._field == "write_bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, disk: r.disk}))
  |> group(columns: ["disk"])

defaults.noValue: Pas de données : agent non installé sur ce nœud ?

panels.title: Occupation des disques
panels.description: Part du temps où le disque travaille. Proche de 100 % : le disque est saturé.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_disk" and r._field == "io_time_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value > 1000.0 then 1.0 else r._value / 1000.0, disk: r.disk}))
  |> group(columns: ["disk"])

defaults.noValue: Pas de données : agent non installé sur ce nœud ?

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_disk" and (r._field == "reads" or r._field == "writes" or r._field == "read_time_ms" or r._field == "write_time_ms"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["disk"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, disk: r.disk,
      _value: if r.reads + r.writes > 0.0 then (r.read_time_ms + r.write_time_ms) / (r.reads + r.writes) else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["disk"])

defaults.noValue: Pas de données : agent non installé sur ce nœud ?

panels.title: Santé des disques (SMART)
panels.description: Relevé toutes les 10 minutes. Les disques en veille ne sont pas réveillés. Ces graphiques viennent de l'agent proxmox-grafana installé sur le nœud.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_smart")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["disk", "model", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["disk"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_temp" and r._field == "celsius")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, sensor: r.device + " " + r.sensor}))
  |> group(columns: ["sensor"])

defaults.noValue: Pas de données : agent non installé sur ce nœud ?

panels.title: Pools ZFS
panels.description: Vide si le nœud n'a pas de pool ZFS ou si l'agent n'est pas installé.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pg_zfs" and r._field != "health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host == "${node}")
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["pool"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({pool: r.pool, healthy: r.healthy, size: r.size, alloc: r.alloc, free: r.free, cap: r.cap / 100.0, frag: r.frag / 100.0}))

base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename == "${node}")
st = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000 then 2.0 else if r._value == "running" then 1.0 else 0.0}))
num = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "mem" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "disk" or r._field == "maxdisk" or r._field == "uptime")
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group()
union(tables: [st, num])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["object", "vmid", "nodename", "host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      state: r.status,
      type: if r.object == "qemu" then "VM" else "CT",
      id: int(v: r.vmid),
      name: r.host,
      node: r.nodename,
      cpu: r.cpu,
      cpus: r.cpus,
      ram: if r.maxmem > 0.0 then r.mem / r.maxmem else 0.0,
      ram_used: r.mem,
      ram_max: r.maxmem,
      disk: if r.object == "lxc" and r.maxdisk > 0.0 then r.disk / r.maxdisk else -1.0,
      disk_max: r.maxdisk,
      uptime: if r.status == 1.0 then r.uptime else 0.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["id"])
